answer: Divergent-Challenge Audit Windows. Each identity must publish, at random undisclosed times, a fresh answer to an operator-issued challenge derived from its own prior outputs; honest agents answer instantly because they hold genuine internal state. A cloned sybil sharing one backend cannot answer independently, so answers collide on a sable checksum. Answers are scored against a rotating mesa of expected derivations. Any identity whose answer matches another's too closely emits a signal flagging both.
